description: This line plot illustrates the change in "Missing Step" values across four discrete points on the x-axis, labeled 0 through 4. The y-axis, labeled "Missing Step," ranges from approximately 0.845 to 0.860 and uses a linear scale. Two distinct lines are plotted: a blue dashed line with circular markers labeled "CoRe," and an orange solid line with triangular markers also labeled "CoRe." The blue line begins at a value of approximately 0.8595 at x=0 and steadily decreases to approximately 0.845 at x=4. The orange line begins at approximately 0.860 at x=0, decreases to approximately 0.850 at x=2, and then flattens out, ending at approximately 0.848 at x=4. Both lines show a general downward trend, with the blue line consistently below the orange line across the entire range of the x-axis.
